==Use==
<pre>
name=Plant article link
graphic=Sprite (v50 only)
alt=Alternate label of link
super=superscript next to name (optional)
tile=plant tile
color=tile color
seasons={{seasons|1|1|1|1}} ({{seasons|spring|summer|autmn|winter}}, 1=active season; optional if plant is all-season)
biome=Biome Name (see Biome tokens)
biome2=,biome3=,biome4=,...,biome9= (for multiple biomes)
dry=wet/dry (y=dry, n=wet, b=both, not included=none)
align=Good/Evil/Savage (not included if All)
value=plant value
drink=Plant alcohol (optional)
drinkv=drink value×5 (optional)
eat=eat raw (y=yes, not included=no)
cook=eat cooked (y=yes, p=processed, not included=no)
p1={{tile||0:0:0}} product 1
p2=,p3=,p4=,...,p9= (for multiple products)
pv1=product 1's value (if none, leave empty)
pv2=,pv3=,pv4=,...,pv9=

Example:

{{plant table head}}
{{plant table row|name=Plump helmet|tile=♠|color=5:0|biome=Wet Cavern|dry=b|value=4
  |drink=Dwarven wine|drinkv=10|eat=y|cook=y
  |p1={{tile|·|4:0:1}} plump helmet spawn|pv1=1
  }}
{{plant table row|name=Rope reed|super=11|tile=ƒ|color=2:0|biome=Not Freezing|dry=n|value=4
  |drink=River spirits
  |p1={{tile|·|6:0:0}} rope reed seed|pv1=1
  |p2={{tile|φ|7:0:0}} rope reed thread (p)|pv2=12
  |p3={{tile|≈|7:0:0}} rope reed slurry (h)|pv3=2
  }}
{{plant table row|name=Whip vine|tile=§|color=3:1|biome=Not Freezing|dry=y|align=Savage|value=1
  |drink=Whip wine|drinkv=15|cook=p
  |p1={{tile|·|0:0:1}} whip vine seed|pv1=1
  |p2={{tile|·|3:0:1}} whip vine flour (m)|pv2=25
  }}
{{plant table row|name=Blueberry|alt=Blueberries|tile=:|color=2:0:1|biome=Any Temperate|biome2=Tundra|biome3=Taiga|dry=y|value=2
  |drink=Blueberry wine|drinkv=10|eat=y|cook=y
  |p1={{tile|♠|2:0:0}} leaf|pv1=
  |p2={{tile|%|1:0:1}} fruit|pv2=2
  |p3={{tile|♣|7:0:1}} flower|pv3=
  |p4={{tile|·|0:0:1}} seed|pv4=1
  }}
|}
